_about: Public-domain Joseph Stevens Buckminster (1784-1812), minister of the Brattle Street Church, Boston, for the Word Hoard: Sermons by the late Rev. J. S. Buckminster (1814), a second volume of Sermons now first published (1829) and The Works of Joseph Stevens Buckminster, with memoirs of his life (1839). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 64 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

buckminster-sermons-1814: Sermons by the late Rev. J. S. Buckminster (Boston, Printed by J. Eliot, 1814)
buckminster-sermons-1829: Sermons by the late Rev. Joseph S. Buckminster : now first published from the author's manuscripts (Boston : Carter and Hendee, 1829)
buckminster-works: The Works of Joseph Stevens Buckminster: With Memoirs of His Life, vol. 2 (J. Munroe, 1839)

_excluded.buckminster-other: His father Joseph Buckminster (1751-1812) of Portsmouth; Eliza Buckminster Lee's memoirs of both
